user.title: Energa My Meter Login
user.description: Enter credentials for Mój Licznik. Meters and OBIS codes will be auto-detected. The last 2 years of history download automatically in the background after setup.

system.title: Settlement system
system.description: Your account has solar export. Pick how Energa settles it (check your invoice if unsure — it cannot be detected automatically).

prices.title: Energy Prices
prices.description: Set energy prices for cost calculation in Energy Panel.

data.bank_initial_kwh: Bank initial kWh (old system, from invoice)
data.bank_initial_pln: Bank initial PLN (new system, from invoice)
data.rce_auto_fetch: Auto-fetch RCEm from PSE API every 24h
data.settlement_date: Annual settlement anniversary YYYY-MM-DD (old system, e.g. invoice date)
data.use_rolling_365d: Old system: rolling 365-day FIFO bank from statistics (needs history)
data.tariff_energy_day: Tariff: sale energy day L1 [PLN/kWh] (from invoice!)
data.tariff_energy_night: Tariff: sale energy night L2 [PLN/kWh] (from invoice!)
data.tariff_trade_fee: Tariff: monthly trade fee [PLN] (from your invoice!)
data.tariff_capacity: Tariff: capacity fee [PLN/month] (empty = auto URE 2026 bracket)
